sections.Profile:
"Super Circus," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1957, is a two-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. The playfield features two flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, and a central roto-target.
